A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same OmniAgent research work, with complete, readable main text and Appendices A–D. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v1 reports original OmniAgent benchmark results, training ablations, scaling and efficiency analyses, and appendix entropy, runtime, and qualitative results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the OmniAgent results in Tables 1–5 and the appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The OTA interaction cycle, memory purging, best-of-N trajectory synthesis, dual-stage filtering, and TAURA objective are unchanged. Adding a teacher-model example in Section 3.2 does not establish a procedural or model replacement.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same five training datasets and ten evaluation benchmarks covering video understanding, audio-visual reasoning, and temporal grounding. No evaluated domain or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1–4, Figure 3, and the runtime comparison in Table 7. The newly mentioned Gemini-3.0-Pro is a teacher-model example, not an added evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The reported metrics, training budgets, context and turn limits, and evaluation procedures are unchanged, including the 100-sample LVBench runtime evaluation. Section 3.2 does not state that the teacher or experimental configuration was changed.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same training-component ablations, test-time scaling, duration and sampling-efficiency analyses, appendix entropy and runtime analyses, and qualitative cases in Figures 6–8.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or revises seed counts, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The descriptive entropy-distribution analysis in Appendix C is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings match. For example, both report 67.8 on VideoMME overall and 50.5 on LVBench in Table 1, 39.1 temporal IoU on LongVALE in Table 3, and 66.8 seconds wall-clock latency for OmniAgent in Table 7.

T1.justification: The POMDP formulation, reward and advantage definitions, TAURA objective in Equations 1–6, and mathematical notation in Appendix A are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about native active perception, duration-independent media overhead, TAURA, benchmark performance, and positive test-time scaling.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning perceptual incompleteness, sampling efficiency, and entropy as a proxy for reasoning criticality are unchanged. Both conclusions acknowledge sequential-interaction latency and propose parallelized exploration as future work.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 adds '(e.g., Gemini-3.0-Pro)' after the previously unspecified 'teacher model.' This supplies a concrete implementation example without definitively identifying the teacher used for every trajectory. Other implementation details, appendix instructions, and code/checkpoint links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, reference list, and novelty positioning are unchanged. The uncited teacher-model example does not revise the paper's relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: The substantive prose edit is the short teacher-model parenthetical in Section 3.2. Section organization and the remaining narrative, including the appendices, are unchanged; the arXiv version/date label is updated.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is resampled from 6960 × 3744 to 3480 × 1872 pixels while retaining its content, caption, and placement. Other figures and tables are unchanged; additional visual differences are limited to the arXiv margin stamp and local paragraph reflow.

improvement.justification: Naming Gemini-3.0-Pro as a teacher-model example makes Section 3.2 slightly more informative than v1's unspecified description. This is a limited documentation gain because 'e.g.' still leaves exact generation provenance unresolved. Scientific evidence and conclusions are unchanged, and Figure 1 remains legible after resampling.
